rules:
The first line contains three integers $$$n$$$, $$$A$$$, $$$B$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 100\,000$$$, $$$1 \le B \le A \le 10^4$$$) — the number of holes, the volume of water Arkady will pour into the system, and the volume he wants to get out of the first hole.

The second line contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$s_1, s_2, \ldots, s_n$$$ ($$$1 \le s_i \le 10^4$$$) — the sizes of the holes. Unique token result under retained description; generated qualification and independent oracle/audit outstanding.
